tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background: ticket cream in light, asphalt in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Game header and blocks that stand out from the background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets that float over the background.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text and focus ring (17:1 in light).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: counters, sign labels. 4.5:1 or more on bg and surface.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative separators and the sleepers of the station line. Not valid as the border of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Border of controls (slider, secondary button): 3:1 or more on bg.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Signal yellow: the main action of each screen. Always with ink text and an ink border in light: on cream it only gives 1.3:1, never as text.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text, icons and border of the main button (12.7:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Reveal celebrations: the inverted sign, black with yellow in light and yellow with black in dark.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent (12.7:1).

tokens.name: option-a
tokens.usage: Dilemmas with 2 options: colour of the first position. Saturated cobalt, same lightness and chroma as option-b (OKLCH).

tokens.name: option-b
tokens.usage: Dilemmas with 2 options: colour of the second position. Magenta, pair of option-a. Never red next to green, nor the brand yellow.

tokens.name: option-1
tokens.usage: Dilemmas with 3 or 4 options: position 1. The four share lightness and chroma (OKLCH 0.515 / 0.16 in light).

tokens.name: option-2
tokens.usage: Dilemmas with 3 or 4 options: position 2 (violet).

tokens.name: option-3
tokens.usage: Dilemmas with 3 or 4 options: position 3 (magenta).

tokens.name: option-4
tokens.usage: Dilemmas with 4 options: position 4 (green). Colours go by position, and the order is shuffled for each player, so no colour is tied to an option.

tokens.name: on-option
tokens.usage: Text on any option colour (5.2:1 or more in light, 8.7:1 or more in dark).

tokens.name: player-teal
tokens.usage: Background of the player avatar, light in both themes so the black strokes of the face can be read.

tokens.name: player-brown
tokens.usage: Background of the player avatar, light in both themes so the black strokes of the face can be read.

tokens.name: on-player
tokens.usage: Stroke of the avatar face (already in the drawing).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Big moments of the reveal: El Mentalista, the podium.

styles.name: dilemma
styles.sample: ¿Desviarías el tranvía para salvar a cinco personas?
styles.usage: The text of each dilemma, in sentence case.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Nadie del grupo verá tu voto.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Counters and labels. With tabular numbers (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: signage
styles.usage: Capitals in the style of station signage: position, sections.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an avatar and its counter.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between items of a row: avatars, the two options.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between rows of a block.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side margin of the screen and padding of blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks of a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Room around the big moments of the reveal.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small labels and the track of the slider.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and dilemma options.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, celebration pills and the thumb of the slider.
